issues.note: Standalone online P2P room and match routes fail explicitly at runtime; OpenAPI and public reference docs now advertise only their 410 retirement responses. The actual four OpenAPI tests and all 17 registered retired operations were verified. Managed MatchLobby/Attempt is the sole online path; transport primitives are not admission fallbacks.

Transport attach/detach is kept separate from Attempt lifecycle; the isolated PostgreSQL P2P lifecycle exercises frozen members attaching while CONNECTING and then a third roster member joining. Native/relay three-client acceptance was not run.

Attempt/roster remains the online authority; BattleLog and presence projections reject client-originated or stale promotion paths and completion leaves the P2P projection incomplete until authoritative terminal handling. No forged live report/closed-collector end-to-end run was available.

Source review confirms the authoritative reservation/idempotency/CAS, release compensation, route refresh, and cleanup-pending retry behavior is implemented across the listed commits and exercised against isolated PostgreSQL. Acceptance remains PARTIAL because per-commit-point process-kill/fault-injection recovery was not executed.

Lobby/authority heartbeats, connection deadlines, reconnect leases, grant deadlines, revocation, and sweeper transitions are explicit. Isolated DB lifecycle covers authority-offline route refresh and expired/revoked admission behavior; delayed live process timing was not run.

Source review confirms Backend implements the documented two-team non-empty start policy and keeps Attempt RUNNING distinct from native playable/role confirmation. Acceptance remains PARTIAL because locked-game role confirmation and late-role native behavior require unavailable Native execution.

Join intent idempotency is distinct from a native handshake: reservation_nonce binds the single reservation, consumed_connection_nonce binds ConfirmConnected, and reserve/confirm/release verify authority session, world, roster/route and connection generations. Double-handshake, old route/generation/world, release, and retry cases pass in isolated PostgreSQL; native client injection is not available.

Same-world route recovery preserves the exact still-live HOST scope/nonce/operation/cursor across route 1→2→3 while updating authority readiness and MEMBER authorization separately. A later real HOST disconnect advances its authorization generation, invalidates the Payload installation gate and requires the refreshed allocation. Toolbox admits this exact Backend-confirmed old HOST proof into the same-route fresh-HOST branch, which requires a new native nonce and CONNECTED proof. Backend, Payload and Toolbox source are aligned; real multi-client HOST recovery remains unrun.

Revalidated after the owned-process and preflight cleanup follow-ups: Backend accepts only exact attempt/session/world/roster/route scope; Dedicated and P2P HOST cleanup require exact evidence shapes. P2P owned_process_exited requires non-zero process_id plus win-filetime start fingerprint; native_process_not_started is only for a P2P HOST before Payload/world publication and requires empty process fields. Real isolated PostgreSQL runs rejected member/non-HOST, malformed evidence, old-world, stale-route, and installed-Payload preflight callbacks, then accepted the exact scoped receipts. Successful transitions persist non-secret scope/evidence metadata in the existing security-audit JSON stream without storing the bearer session. Actual OS child-handle/pre-spawn proof remains the Toolbox supervisor responsibility.

Dedicated allocation requires exact strict-roster-v2 capability, locked game hash and Payload attestation; cleanup-pending servers remain isolated from READY reuse. Isolated DB coverage passed, but a live old/native_unverified server and real registration assignment were not run.

Dedicated registration consumes active_match assignment, validates authority/session/world/roster/route scope, drives RESERVED -> NATIVE_ADMITTED -> CONNECTED, reports nonce-scoped disconnects, and uses scoped cleanup. The registration worker now receives the real spawned game child PID. Actual registered agent + Payload IPC + game assignment could not be run.

Dedicated manager now holds a duplicated handle for the spawned child and registration sends owned_process_exited only after the handle is signalled and the exit code is final; scope mismatches and malformed evidence are rejected. Backend additionally accepts the strictly scoped P2P native_process_not_started preflight marker only before Payload/world publication and records the receipt without the bearer session. Native cleanup_pending remains retained until a final scoped ACK with world_teardown_required=false. Real native teardown, consecutive-game reuse, final ACK, and the supervisor's pre-spawn marker integration were not available, so acceptance remains BLOCKED.

Strict authoritative online mode is now unconditional: the retired strict_roster_v1_enabled YAML/env inputs fail explicitly; accept_new_lobbies only rejects Create while Get/List/Active/Join/heartbeat/admission/cleanup continue for existing attempts. The real isolated PostgreSQL integration passed force-abort audit/cleanup and a draining service read/create negative. A concurrent two-control-plane process run was not executed; the single-process integration is the recorded scope. The final focused strict-gate run also proves missing admission signing keys are rejected in development, test, and production; only deterministic test seeds are used in tests. The HTTP unit run preserves 401/403 and service 404/409/400 statuses through the cross-package error boundary; the real PostgreSQL force-abort transaction is recorded separately. No empty-key or disabled-signer runtime path remains.

Append-only migrations 44–48 preserve existing service data. Migration 48 separates live and authorized generation/route; only nonce-bound live HOST rows retain a preservation acknowledgement. Missing-nonce historical HOST/MEMBER rows cannot satisfy live quorum. Startup verifies migration names/content checksums and rejects future versions. Embedded SQL execution/checksums now canonicalize CRLF to LF, while verification accepts only the exact known historical CRLF representation; SQL content drift remains rejected. The actual pre-fix line-ending regression failed, and both post-fix unit tests passed. Historical schema48-as-future rejection was executed while the embedded maximum was47 and is not a current-schema claim. Actual database restore and role/ACL executions are retained separately; trust-only local DB authentication does not prove password rejection.
